principles: cross-project live integration uses HTTP APIs

services.name: Research Hub
services.role: Unified local entry point with service links and health status.
notes: Implemented as a stdlib-only local Python server.
Run with python3 -m research_hub --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3030.
Must not iframe sibling frontends.
Must not merge sibling UI code.

services.name: moomoo OpenD Gateway
services.role: Local moomoo gateway used by py-moomoo-api for read-only account and market access.
notes: Must be started and logged in outside research-stack.
research-stack does not manage trading credentials.

services.name: moomoo Account Web
services.role: Read-only account, positions, watchlist, and research-universe export source.
notes: Exports research universe at GET /api/research-universe/export.
May call Market Data Lab read-only snapshot and status endpoints.
Watchlists default to local cache and require manual OpenD sync in the source project.

services.name: Market Data Lab API
services.role: Market history, technical indicators, chart data, screen data, and universe center.
notes: Reads moomoo via GET /api/research-universe/export.
Must not read moomoo cache files directly.
HTTP Firn watchlist sync is the target integration direction.

services.name: Market Data Lab UI
services.role: Charts, screen, universe, and refresh visibility frontend.
notes: Vite development UI proxies API requests to Market Data Lab API.

services.name: Firn API
services.role: Audit, evidence, knowledge base, claim verification, digest, and research API.
notes: Authenticated routes require Firn auth state.
Research Hub health checks should use /api/health.
Future Market Data Lab watchlist sync should use HTTP rather than file coupling.

services.name: Firn UI
services.role: Analysis Theater, Digest Theater, KB Explorer, and audit citation frontend.
notes: Next.js frontend should stay independent.

services.name: TradingAgents API
services.role: Deep ticker and portfolio-style agent analysis API with markdown report output.
notes: Project default API port is 8000; research-stack reserves 8002 to avoid Firn.
Future ticker selection should come from Market Data Lab via HTTP.
Reports are markdown artifacts exposed by the TradingAgents API.

services.name: TradingAgents UI
services.role: TradingAgents web console and markdown report browser.
notes: Set VITE_API_BASE_URL to http://127.0.0.1:8002 in research-stack local runs.

services.name: DailyBrief Pipeline
services.role: Local-first Python AI news and markets digest generator that writes static HTML reports.
notes: DailyBrief is the current daily report pipeline tracked by research-stack.
DailyBrief has no database, web server, web framework, or frontend service.
Reports are static files under daily_reports/<YYYY-MM-DD>/.
Useful commands include dailybrief daily, dailybrief build-site, dailybrief open, and dailybrief run-scheduled.
